verdict.rationale:
Azure CLI, REST APIs, and IaC tools (ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform) all support scripting and declarative deployment across many resources at once, and JMESPath querying/tab-completion supports programmatic bulk workflows (azure-docs-1, azure-gh-2, azure-docs-6, azure-docs-7, azure-docs-8). Cost Management APIs also allow multidimensional bulk queries across resources (azure-docs-22).

missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-operation/batch API or CLI subcommand for acting on many items in one call, and independent hands-on evidence confirming large-scale bulk operations work smoothly in practice.
